observations: FY2014 budget targets were 8.00 million tonnes of cement sales, RMB 2,317.80 million of revenue and RMB 2,293.50 million of costs and expenses.
Reported completion was 94.30% of the volume target, 88.96% of the revenue target and 88.78% of the cost-and-expense budget.
cell_settlements.interpretation: The filing reports plan progress, but target completion does not establish implementation or execution of the frozen channel, terminal-partner and logistics mechanism.

observations: Several production and efficiency projects were commissioned or entered trial production during FY2014.
The filing does not identify a qualifying FY2014 launch, opening, signing or committed-resource event for the frozen channel, terminal-partner or logistics mechanism.
Unified sales through the Furun venture began in February 2015, after the FY2014 operating period.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 9 and 17-18
cell_settlements.interpretation: Project implementation is observed locally, while implementation of the primary commercial mechanism remains unverified.

observations: The filing reports production projects operating or entering trial operation.
It provides no FY2014 channel count, terminal-partner count, logistics coverage or other meaningful operating scope for the frozen commercial mechanism.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 9-10 and 17
cell_settlements.interpretation: Execution is visible for production projects but remains unknown for the channel, terminal-partner and logistics mechanism under review.

observations: The top five customers represented 12.98% of revenue.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 10 and 15
cell_settlements.interpretation: Customer response cannot be inferred from aggregate sales volume or customer concentration.

observations: Aggregate cement-plus-clinker sales were 7.8314 million tonnes, up 21.88% year on year.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 9 and 12-13
cell_settlements.interpretation: The aggregate observation supports volume progress only. It cannot settle the frozen component measurement or attribute volume to channel execution.

observations: Average pretax cement price fell 5.19%, aggregate product price fell 6.95%, and average cement price fell RMB 14.84 per tonne.
Selling expense rose 14.68% to RMB 58.884 million.
Cement gross margin was 16.73%, up 4.16 percentage points because reported cost reduction exceeded the price decline.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 9-13 and 102-103
cell_settlements.interpretation: Unit economics improved under price pressure, supporting the unit-economics H-A at the issuer boundary. This does not establish channel causality or management-action effect.

observations: Receivables fell 39.86% to RMB 7.769 million while inventory rose 23.30% to RMB 224.431 million.
Audited consolidated operating cash flow rose 18.87% to RMB 295.226 million.
Operating-cash-to-revenue was 14.32%, compared with 13.65% in FY2013.
Management attributed part of the cash improvement to lower input prices and greater use of bills for raw-material settlement.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 10, 12, 14, 45 and 51-52
cell_settlements.interpretation: Cash and receivables improved, inventory moved against that progress, and the stated drivers include procurement prices and settlement method. The channel plan's cash effect and owner cash remain unknown.

observations: Cash paid for fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets was RMB 334.225 million, exceeding operating cash flow of RMB 295.226 million.
Short-term borrowings rose to RMB 1.815 billion and the company added finance-lease and sale-and-leaseback obligations.
Management stated that operating cash was insufficient for project development and that current liquidity depended on controller support.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 14, 19, 45-46, 52, 98, 103 and 107
missing_facts: causal attribution between the frozen commercial plan and capital productivity
cell_settlements.interpretation: The evidence supports a material capital-burden counterargument but cannot settle causal or durable capital return.

observations: The company recorded RMB 17.987 million of impairment, including RMB 5.315 million of construction-in-progress impairment associated with cancelled projects.
The report states that short-term and long-term borrowings had no overdue issuer obligations and contains an unqualified audit opinion.
evidence_locators: FY2014 annual report PDF pp. 1, 44, 59, 93, 98 and 103-104
cell_settlements.interpretation: Local realized capital losses are observed, but one filing does not establish issuer-level permanent loss or remove the financing risk.

thread_feedback.statement: Aggregate volume progress is real, but the frozen channel, terminal-partner and logistics action is not shown as implemented or executed during FY2014 and customer response is unobserved. H-A is therefore not established; H-B remains a live rival rather than a proven cause.

Cement margin improved despite falling price because reported cost reduction more than offset price pressure. The result supports the local unit-economics mechanism, not the commercial-plan attribution.
Operating cash and receivables improved, while inventory rose, capex exceeded operating cash and financing dependence remained material. Capital return and permanent loss remain unknown.

next_cutoff_research_agenda_delta.change: Require explicit launch date and operating scope for channel, terminal-partner and logistics actions before treating later sales as execution evidence.
Collect direct customer or channel response and separate cement from clinker volume before testing the first commercial transmission link.
Decompose unit-economics improvement into input-price, operating-efficiency, utilization and commercial effects before attributing margin progress to management action.
Read operating cash together with inventory, capex, debt and financing support before making owner-cash, capital-return or permanent-loss claims.

investor_conclusion: Fujian Cement's FY2014 operating results improved, especially volume, cement margin and operating cash, but the filing does not prove that the frozen channel, terminal-partner and logistics mechanism was implemented or executed during FY2014. Customer response is still unobserved, while capex and financing dependence keep the capital-return question open.
enterprise_learning_reason: This settlement changes the next cutoff research agenda for CN:600802, but it has not yet changed another company-cutoff's pre-outcome mechanism or forecast fields and has not received an independent learning-transfer review.
